answer: Only beacon mints nontransferable jade: one token per round of judged work for each audited controller, however many keys it runs. garden holds that controller’s jade and lifetime head count through wallet rotation. Admission burns jade equal to the square of the resulting head count in one payment. Ten heads consume 385 serial work-rounds, and head ten alone costs 100; clones cannot parallelise earnings or split payment. Another controller’s first head still burns one jade.
